miolo.title: The Alleys & Secret Viewpoints
miolo.description: Walk through historic alleyways, understand living architecture, and gaze at Rio de Janeiro's most breathtaking panoramas.
miolo.card1Desc: Unique community engineering built over decades.
miolo.card2Desc: 360° panoramic view of São Conrado, Gávea Rock, and the Atlantic Ocean.
miolo.card3Desc: Genuine conversations with local shopkeepers, artisans, and families.

arte.title: Art, Music & Local Flavors
arte.description: An explosion of color and rhythm inside the heart of the community.
arte.pin1Desc: Open-air street art gallery featuring renowned favela artists.
arte.pin2Desc: Ancestral rhythm and modern street tradition passed down through generations.
arte.pin3Desc: Taste authentic local dishes in traditional community eateries.

base.title: Community Base: Local Economy & Positive Impact
base.description: Your visit directly supports local families, social projects, and micro-entrepreneurs in Rocinha.
base.ctaDesc: Secure your tour spot with personalized WhatsApp assistance in your preferred language.
base.whatsappBtn: Book with Local Host on WhatsApp

footer.faqA1: Yes! Our tour is led exclusively by experienced local residents who were born and live in Rocinha. Safety, hospitality, and community respect are our absolute priorities.
footer.faqQ2: What is the duration and difficulty?
footer.faqA2: Approximately 3 to 4 hours. A moderate walk with frequent stops, suitable for all ages.
footer.faqQ3: How do booking and payment work?
footer.faqA3: Simply select your preferred date on our calendar, enter your name, and choose the number of guests. You'll connect directly with your local host via WhatsApp with all details ready for fast confirmation, with no advance fees.
